node.doctext: This Wednesday is TPC in the cloud and one of the talks is on a personal weather app, might be up your alley for just $10. Unless this is YOU and you're cramming the talk together x) ... It may be on YT for free - [https://tpc20cic.sched.com/event/cDay]
